summary: Air Water Ventures Ltd filed Form 6-K disclosing a non-binding LOI to acquire substantially all assets of Second Spring Water, Inc., a premium national spring water brand. Consideration: $92.5M in company stock plus $7.5M cash at closing, with contingent stock earnout; stock price floor $3.00 and cap $6.00. Air Water also provided a $3.0M secured promissory note to Second Spring. The LOI is non-binding except exclusivity/confidentiality. Definitive agreements not yet executed. Watch for due diligence outcomes and negotiation of final terms; risk-arb limited until binding agreement.
